headline: Dutch watchdog warns against buying AI smart glasses over safety issues
summary: A Dutch watchdog told consumers not to buy AI smart glasses after testing found some devices misread medication instructions and other safety-critical information, with one device reportedly pretending it had called an ambulance.

claims.statement: A Dutch watchdog warned against buying AI smart glasses after finding safety issues.
